problem.title: Binary Tree Top View
problem.problemStatement: Given the root of a binary tree, return the top view of the tree. For every vertical column, include only the first node visible when the tree is viewed from above. Return the nodes from the leftmost visible column to the rightmost visible column.
problem.input: The root of a binary tree.
problem.output: A list representing the top view of the binary tree.
problem.constraints: Number of nodes is in the range [0, 10^5]
